_README: Ongoing story threads for cross-day memory. The cloud agent appends/updates threads each run and prunes stale ones. Format per thread: {"id", "title", "first_seen", "last_update", "summary", "status"}.

threads.title: US-Iran military escalation
threads.summary: Iran fired missiles at US forces in Jordan (intercepted); US and Saudi jets struck Iran-aligned targets in Iraq in response to prior drone attacks. No new escalation reported as of July 30.

threads.title: Hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout
threads.summary: Google raised 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B; Microsoft/3M, SoftBank France (5GW/E75B), and Chevron/Microsoft Texas power deal all point to accelerating AI data-center investment. Now confirmed: Nvidia is in talks for a ~$250B guarantee backing OpenAI's $500B, 10GW Ohio data-center lease (SoftBank's SB Energy), plus a separate ~$350B facility for OpenAI's chip purchases; analysts have begun calling the structure 'circular financing.' Same week, chip stocks (Nvidia, SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron, AMD, TSMC) shed over $1 trillion in combined market cap on doubts about AI capex sustainability.

threads.title: Cisco SD-WAN active-exploitation campaign
threads.summary: State-aligned actor UAT-8616 has exploited seven Cisco SD-WAN zero-days in 2026 against government/critical-infrastructure targets; campaign remains active. No new disclosures as of July 30.

threads.title: France/Spain wildfires and heat wave
threads.summary: Wildfires have displaced roughly 330,000 people across France and Spain, the largest peacetime evacuation in French history; a new heat spike is forecast. No confirmed new figures as of July 30.

threads.title: Japan (Kumamoto) earthquake recovery
threads.summary: Magnitude-7.1 quake near Kumamoto: death toll has climbed from 18 (July 29) to a range of 25-34 depending on outlet/confirmation criteria as of July 30. Rescue operations continue at a collapsed shopping mall and a paper mill; over 10,000 remain in evacuation shelters.

threads.title: Fauci Senate hearing / contempt-of-Congress threat
threads.summary: Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment 100+ times in a Senate Judiciary hearing on COVID's origins. Committee chair Rand Paul plans a contempt-of-Congress vote next week; a referral would go to DOJ.

threads.title: Fed rate decisions
threads.summary: Fed held its benchmark rate at 3.5%-3.75% for a fifth straight meeting on July 29, with three FOMC members dissenting in favor of a hike. Stocks fell on the news; 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007.
